purpose: Reference data for future AI sleep guidance. Evidence and product heuristics are separate.

knowledge.claim: Consistent sleep and wake times can support sleep habits.
Quiet time before bed and reducing bright screen light are suggested sleep habits.
A quiet, cool, dark bedroom can support sleep.
Sleep needs depend on age; guidance lists 8–10 hours for teens aged 13–18 and at least 7 hours for adults.
knowledge.not_supported: An exact optimal duration for every individual

knowledge.claim: Dreaming occurs in sleep and its precise purpose remains uncertain.
knowledge.not_supported: Inferring sleep stages, sleep quality, disease, or future events from dream content alone

inputs.nightmare: optional distressing dream awakening; advice only

product_heuristic.age_limitation: Legacy age bands do not distinguish 10–12 from 13–19. Age-band approximation requires replacement with an approved age-specific rule before clinical use.
product_heuristic.aggregation: Most recently updated valid report for each local calendar date in the last 7 calendar days; average available scores; no report means unmeasured, never level 1.
warnings: High score does not rule out a sleep disorder
Long sleep is not automatically evidence of good sleep
Weights and levels are product choices, not findings from the cited sources
